title: Convert slugs and filesystem names by swapping hyphens and underscores

facts.note: Task text mentions wagon/feature slugs or their directory/file names.

Covers both conversion directions: creating/renaming a directory or feature file from a slug, reading an existing directory/filename to recover its slug, and deriving a slug from a name independently of any filesystem change.

values: slug referenced alongside a directory or feature filename
facts.note: Requires a diff-level observer that pairs a declared or referenced slug with its directory or feature filename and checks the mapping. No path restriction is applied; wagon/feature artifacts may live anywhere in the repository.

fires: Planner creates a new wagon whose kebab-case slug must become a snake_case directory name.
Planner adds a feature whose slug must become a snake_case .yaml filename.
Planner derives a slug from a human wagon/feature name containing spaces, capitals or underscores, with or without creating any file.
Planner reads an existing wagon directory or feature filename and references its logical slug in a plan, URN or doc.
doesNotFire: Editing the content of an existing wagon or feature without touching, deriving or referencing its slug, directory or filename.
Naming files or directories that are not wagon directories or feature files (e.g. source code modules).

given: A planner artifact needs a wagon or feature slug or its filesystem counterpart (directory name or feature .yaml filename).
when: Deriving a slug from a name, or converting between a slug and its directory/filename in either direction.
then: Use only the conversion functions: derive slug = lowercase the name, replace spaces/underscores with hyphens; slug→dirname = slug.replace('-', '_'); dirname→slug = dirname.replace('_', '-'); feature slug→filename = feature_slug.replace('-', '_') + '.yaml'; filename→slug = filename.replace('_', '-').replace('.yaml', '').
prefer: Verb-object phrasing for slugs (preferred, not required).
avoid: Any other slug↔filesystem transformation (abbreviating, reordering, dropping words).
Hyphens in wagon directory or feature filenames; spaces, underscores or capitals in slugs.
why: Logical slugs are kebab-case and filesystem names snake_case; the conversion functions are pure hyphen/underscore swaps between them.
evidence: For every wagon, dirname.replace('_', '-') equals its declared slug and slug.replace('-', '_') equals its directory name.
For every feature, feature_slug.replace('-', '_') + '.yaml' equals its filename and filename.replace('_', '-').replace('.yaml', '') equals its slug.
Every slug is lowercase with hyphens only (no spaces or underscores).
verifier_detail: Term 'conversion' = the kebab<->snake conversion functions: slug_to_dirname: slug.replace('-', '_'); dirname_to_slug: dirname.replace('_', '-'); feature_slug_to_filename: feature_slug.replace('-', '_') + '.yaml'; feature_filename_to_slug: filename.replace('_', '-').replace('.yaml', ''); slug_derivation: lowercase, replace spaces/underscores with hyphens (verb-object preferred).
Lowercasing and space/underscore→hyphen replacement are mandatory in slug derivation; verb-object phrasing is preferred, not mandatory — do not fail on it alone.

additions.justification: Negative restatement of the source conversion and derivation functions so the planner sees concrete anti-patterns; adds no new obligation.
